Adjusted assessment: The FOMC statement is moderately positive—solid growth, low and stable unemployment, and risks judged roughly in balance with policy on hold. The latest Financial Stability Report (published in October 2024) tempers that tone by highlighting vulnerabilities in commercial real estate, elevated nonbank liquidity and funding risks (including money market funds and their linkages to Treasury bills and stablecoins), and potential market-functioning strains amid high Treasury supply, alongside geopolitical and fiscal risks. While banks appear resilient and hedge funds have reduced leverage, credit and market vulnerabilities persist. Net: still positive, but more cautious than the base snippet.
